component.name: celPix
component.summary: Graphics viewer and editor for romhacking and research

description.p: celPix finds, views and edits the graphics inside retro-game ROMs and dumps. It reads a wide range of pixel and palette formats, decompresses the common console compression schemes, and writes edited pixels and palettes back to the original file.

ul.li: A wide variety of pixel and palette formats
Compression with a decompressed preview and in-place editing
Tilemaps, spritemaps and fontmaps that render a ROM's own maps, sprites and text
Drawing tools with undo/redo and copy/paste to external image editors
Indexed and RGB PNG import and export
Slices, bookmarks and projects that save a session to pick up later
Plugins for custom formats, from config files to full Python code
